verdict.rationale: Persona documents machine-consumable outcomes: webhooks report approved, declined or needs-review status, the API can be polled for inquiry statuses and verification details, and reports and workflows add risk signals such as watchlist/PEP results and high-risk tagging. An automated flow can branch on these, but the evidence never shows the structure of per-check results or failure reasons. Missing for 10: documented per-check result fields, machine-readable failure reason codes, risk score/signal payload schema, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, verification outcomes come back structured enough for an agent to decide on — machine-readable check results, risk signals, and failure reasons an automated onboarding flow can branch on

citations.quote: Set up webhooks to receive real-time status updates when a user is approved, declined, or requires further review.
Poll the API for the latest inquiry statuses or fetch specific verification details without disrupting your primary integration.
you can create a workflow to automatically tag high-risk inquiries, run additional reports when specific conditions are met
Persona supports many report types, including: Address Lookup, Adverse Media, ... Politically Exposed Person, Watchlist
